body: Runner reminder (from PR A): every workflow names the image ubuntu-26.04 instead of ubuntu-latest, because GitHub moves that label from 24.04 to 26.04 during November 2026 (runner-images issue 14748). It is a deliberate choice, not a stop-gap. Removal trigger: when GitHub announces the end of the 26.04 image, move all workflows to the then-current image in one pull request. Dependabot (monthly, actions only) keeps the actions current; the app, server and Android toolchain are upgraded on purpose (PR B).
